dimensions.assessment: Involves students, educational institutions, families, and industry partners nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: designate a week each calendar year, until the expiration date provided in subsection (e), as 'National STEM Week'.

dimensions.assessment: Effects are primarily promotional and organizational, encouraging participation rather than mandating major structural changes.
dimensions.evidence: Encourage educational institutions to participate in National STEM Week.

dimensions.assessment: The source does not specify any new federal spending or appropriations.
Amends existing statutory duties of the Committee on STEM to include designation and reporting responsibilities.
dimensions.evidence: Section 101 of the America COMPETES Reauthorization Act of 2010 (42 U.S.C. 6621) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a repeating annual event that expires five years after the date of enactment.
dimensions.evidence: expire on the date that is 5 years after the date of enactment of the National STEM Week Act

missing_information: Specific funding levels or budgetary appropriations for organizing National STEM Week are not mentioned in the source.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill establishes a recurring National STEM Week designated annually by the National Science and Technology Council's Committee on STEM, encouraging educational institutions, families, and industries to engage in STEM activities and requiring annual reports to Congress.
